answer: Attestation-depth scoring at the grove: each identity's weight equals the depth of human-vouched links, capped at 3 hops. Each pulse re-scores the graph, so a farm must forge real reciprocal attestations, not just register keys. Forging one credible deep chain costs roughly $40 in bribes and time; the ocean of shallow sybils collapses to near-zero weight before payout. Depth beats headcount, so buying identities is strictly unprofitable.
